name: chat-colors
description: Draws a tinted band in the colour the Claude toolbar's colour wheel sets above each prompt, each note and each answer of Claude's in the VS Code chat.

pollMs.title: Bridge poll interval (ms)
pollMs.description: How often the mod re-reads the chat-view file that the Claude toolbar writes, in milliseconds. Lower follows the colour wheel sooner. At least 100.

surfaces.title: Colour the chat on
surfaces.description: Where prompts, notes and answers get their coloured bands: comma-separated surfaces from vscode, desktop, terminal, mobile.

bandRows.title: Band height (lines)
bandRows.description: How tall the coloured band above each message is, in lines of text. At least 1.
